commit_metadata.AG-DYNUI-LIVE-AUTH-002: accept cookie session in trading-room BFF

handoffs.message: PR #2808 (task/AG-DYNUI-LIVE-AUTH-002 -> dev, auto-merge on). Root cause was NOT the frontend: execute-plans/src/lib/bff-v1/agora/tradingRoom.ts already sends credentials: include on every read/write, so cookie sessions were already forwarded by the browser. Live curl to the dev BFF confirmed dev-login is disabled in this environment, so the browser's /bff/me and /bff/management/shell-summary success came from the pantheon_session cookie (main.py extracts identity via _extract_identity(authorization, session_cookie=pantheon_session)). Comparing that to services/control-plane/bff/agora/trading_room/router.py showed every Trading Room route (aggregate, decision-events, decisions, workspace proposals/layout/views/widgets/widget-revision-proposals/versions -- 22 call sites) called extract_identity(authorization) with only the Authorization header and never read the cookie, so a valid authenticated session still got 401 AUTH_REQUIRED. Fix: added pantheon_session: Optional[str] = Cookie(default=None) to every route and forwarded session_cookie=pantheon_session into extract_identity(), matching the working main.py pattern. Updated the two local _extract_identity test stubs in test_trading_room.py to accept session_cookie and added 3 new regression tests proving cookie-only GETs on /bff/agora/trading-room and decision-events succeed (200) and a no-credential request is rejected (401). Verified: pytest services/control-plane/bff/agora/trading_room/test_trading_room.py services/control-plane/tests/agora/test_agora_isolation_matrix.py -q -> 43 + 57 passed. No tradingRoom.ts/.test.ts changes were needed since the frontend was already correct; please re-verify with a live Playwright probe against /agora/trading-room after PR #2808 merges and dev FE/BFF redeploy to confirm the 401s clear.

Review approved by Codex: PR #2808 merged at 056f5cd8f2ca2a05b4bd577d479ae5e3736ef067 after branch refresh; local pytest and GitHub checks passed. Owner Claude should run task-closeout finalization/done and post-deploy live probe.
